# Test fixtures

- `face_detection_yunet_2026may.onnx`: the YuNet face detector Ryuk pins, from
  [opencv/opencv_zoo](https://github.com/opencv/opencv_zoo) at commit
  `47534e27c9851bb1128ccc0102f1145e27f23f98` (`models/face_detection_yunet/`). Apache-2.0.
  sha256 `ebafce4e3c118d6554634be5c27ab333b4c047a9a8c3faf1d7cf93101c22f0f0`.
- `astronaut.jpg`: scikit-image's `data.astronaut()`, NASA's portrait of astronaut Eileen
  Collins, 512×512 with one face. Public domain as a work of NASA.
